    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    foreground = next(value for value in counts if value != background)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    bands = []
    r = 0
    while r < h:
        while r < h and foreground not in grid[r]:
            r += 1
        if r == h:
            break
        start = r
        while r < h and foreground in grid[r]:
            r += 1
        bands.append((start, r))

    for start, end in bands:
        right = max(c for row in grid[start:end] for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == foreground)
        for r in range(start, end):
            cols = [c for c, value in enumerate(grid[r]) if value == foreground]
            c = max(cols)
            if c < w - 1 and (c == right or (c == right - 1 and (c == 0 or grid[r][c - 1] != foreground))):
                step = 1 if c > 0 and grid[r][c - 1] == foreground else 2
                for y in range(c + step, w, step):
                    out[r][y] = 1
    return out
'''
